title: Banu asad ke shareef logo
body:
Mai ek ghareeb ul watan musafir
Banu asad ke shareef logo
Mai ek ghareeb ul watan musafir..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Tumhari basti ke paas khaime laga chuka hu
mai aa'nth din tak yehi rahunga
tum aathwe roz shaam ke waqt is taraf aake dekh lena
agar tum is dasht e be amaa'n mein
kati phati sar burida laasho ke tukde dekho to dafn karke..(2)
<<MINI>>
reza o khushnudiye risalat mu'aab lena
khuda se ajr o sawaab lena

2. Haye..
Banu asad ki hijaab mein baithi bibiyo'n
agar ye dekho ke waqt ke hukmura ki dehshat se khauf se
mard ghar se bahar nikal na paayein to tum zara der ko nikal kar
hamari laasho ko ret ke sar buland teelo'n se dhaanp dena
<<MINI>>

3. Banu asad ke dulare baccho'n
tumhare maa baap khauf o dehshat se
ghar se bahar nikal na paaye to aisa karna.. to aisa karna
to khelte khelte nikal kar hamari laasho ke paas aana aur apne haatho'n mein ret bhar kar
hamari laasho pe daal dena
meri sakina duaein degi
